decisions.reason: After several years and no recent website visibility, this core handle family likely sits below aspiration relative to stronger internal lines, so we would redeploy resources to better-performing ranges and new development.
As a single design variant with two years of non-observation, it is more exposed to falling short of aspiration and is a natural candidate for pruning in favor of more successful core designs.
Like other standalone handle designs, prolonged weak visibility after launch suggests performance uncertainty has turned negative enough to justify withdrawal and resource reallocation.
Although it supports portfolio breadth, the lack of recent market presence indicates this family has likely not met aspiration strongly enough to keep occupying attention and catalogue space.

Despite its strategic fit with digital building organization, two years without visible market presence suggest this specific system has likely been overtaken or underperformed, so resources are better shifted to newer digital access developments.
